menu_options.account: Sign in with a Narwal account (recommended)

account.title: Sign in to Narwal Cloud
account.description: Use the email and password registered in the Narwal app. Credentials stay only in your Home Assistant config entry and are never written to integration logs or GitHub.

token.title: Connect with app tokens
token.description: Enter the access and refresh tokens extracted from the Narwal app. [How to obtain tokens]({token_guide_url})

reconfigure.title: Switch to automatic account login
reconfigure.description: Enter the Narwal account that owns or has been invited to this robot. This replaces manual token management.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Narwal Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The saved Narwal session could not be renewed. Enter the account credentials again.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Narwal Cloud. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Narwal rejected the email or password.
error.device_not_found: This account cannot access the previously configured robot. Invite this account from the main Narwal account first.

abort.already_configured: This Narwal robot is already configured.
abort.no_devices: No Narwal robot is linked or shared with this account.
abort.invalid_response: Narwal Cloud returned incomplete device information.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Automatic Narwal account login is now enabled.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant requests the latest Narwal state. The default and minimum is 1 second. Increase it to reduce cloud and network traffic.
